reviews.text: Create your own character and face the horrors ahead in this rogue-like
https://twitch.tv/CodeRadGames An awesome rogue-light with amazing procedural animations. Very visually stimulating stream!
Part of the 2025 Pirate Indie Games Show. Interview: https://youtu.be/W3kiLeQxfm0 See all of the games here: https://show.games
Character creator uses body types instead of sex/gender with male/female options.
First Impressions: A Dark Fantasy Skill-Based Soulslike Roguelite. Amazing atmosphere. Challenging, rewarding combat with interesting build choices. Fun!
